$comment: Store preview video settings for demo-capture.mjs --preview (factory). Times are OUTPUT seconds (after trim + speed). Captions follow the 2026-10-17 caption standard: benefit wording, sentence case, 8 words max, no price/promo words, light mode. `stores.<key>` overrides the top level per surface. Tuned 2026-10-17 against the recorded raws (qa/captures/.preview-<store>/raw.mp4): settle drops the app's own splash after the auto-detected launch; Android's launcher wallpaper is not auto-detected, so its trimStart is explicit (the list is on screen from ~21.5 s raw, after a brief empty-state flash); Maestro taps are slower on iPad and Android, hence the higher speeds there. Re-record = re-tune these numbers from a --keep-intermediate run.
